landing.subtitle: A fully digitized rotating savings platform — daily contributions, weekly draws, mutual Takaful protection, and a Sharia board at its core. Qard al-Hasan · Ujrah · Amanah.
landing.f1Body: Seeded RNG selects 7 winners per weekly event — auditable, no human touch.
landing.f2Body: Mutual tabarru' fund absorbs hardship — cooperative, non-profit, Sharia-governed.
landing.f3Body: Qard al-Hasan principal returns — no riba, no gambling, no turn-selling.
landing.f4Body: Onboarding, guarantors, collateral, penalties and disputes — end to end.
landing.ctaTitle: Run your Ekub, the halal way
landing.ctaBody: Manage schemes, cycles, draws, payouts and Takaful from one Sharia-compliant console.
landing.footer: Emad Halal Ekub · Qard al-Hasan · Ujrah · Amanah
landing.howSubtitle: From sign-up to payout — three simple steps in the member app.
landing.s1Body: Sign up with your phone, get peer + admin approved, and watch your Ekub savings grow — 0% interest, Sharia-audited.
landing.s2Body: Pay in one tap via mobile money, bank transfer or agent cash. Your schedule and ledger update in real time.
landing.s3Body: Check in during the live session. A provably-fair RNG selects 7 winners — no human touch, fully auditable.
landing.dlBody: Contribute, follow the live draw, and track your Takaful protection — all from your phone.
landing.pQardBody: You get back exactly what you put in — a benevolent loan, never interest.
landing.pUjrahBody: A flat, transparent service fee for administering the Ekub — not a return on money.
landing.pAmanahBody: Contributions are held in trust and paid to winners without diversion or delay.
landing.tiersSub: Every birr is itemised up front — contribution, service fee (Ujrah) and Takaful. No interest, no hidden charges.
landing.payTitle: Pay the way you already pay
landing.paySub: Contribute in one tap — or hand cash to your agent and get a digital receipt instantly.
landing.payMobileD: Instant wallet transfer, reconciled in real time.
landing.payBankD: Direct from your account, matched automatically.
landing.payAgentD: Pay your field agent — receipt syncs to your ledger.
landing.secTitle: Built to be trusted with your money
landing.secSub: Cooperative-licensed, Sharia-governed, and auditable end to end.
landing.sec1B: Operated under a registered Savings & Credit Cooperative — your funds sit behind a legal entity, not an informal arrangement.
landing.sec2B: An independent board governs the rules and is the final arbiter on any dispute.
landing.sec3B: Every member is KYC-verified with a national Fayda ID before joining a cycle.
landing.sec4B: Every payment, draw and approval is append-only logged — results can never be silently edited.
landing.a1: Yes. Payouts are Qard al-Hasan — you receive exactly the pot your group contributed, never a penny of interest. Our only charge is a flat Ujrah service fee, shown up front on every tier.
landing.a2: A seeded random number generator picks 7 winners per weekly draw from everyone who is paid up. No admin can influence or reverse a result, and every draw's seed and proof is viewable in the app.
landing.q3: What happens if I miss a payment?
landing.a3: A first miss is a warning. A second consecutive miss suspends you from the next 3 draws (ta'zir) while your obligation continues. There is never a monetary late fee — that would be riba.
landing.q4: What protects me if another member defaults?
landing.a4: The Takaful fund. Every member donates a small tabarru' each round into a mutual pool that absorbs hardship, backed by guarantors and collateral on the larger tiers.
landing.q5: Can I sell or swap my turn?
landing.a5: No. Selling, auctioning or discounting a turn is haram and is blocked in the system itself — attempting it means permanent removal.
